title: Your First Weekend at Carroll College, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Move-In at Guadalupe Hall
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Start your journey at 'Guad,' the primary first-year residence. Check in at the parking lot tent to get your keys and begin settling into your new home.
cards.short_summary: The primary residence hall for first-year students and the starting point for move-in day.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-in day for new students is Sunday, August 23, with check-in at the Guadalupe Hall parking lot tent from 8 a.m. to noon.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled move-in on Sunday morning; student ID required for building access thereafter.

cards.title: Lunch at the STAC
cards.subtitle: Refuel Between Sessions
cards.notes: Head to the Campus Center for your first meal. The STAC offers continuous dining options and serves as a central gathering spot for new students.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall located in the Campus Center, known as the STAC.
cards.evidence_claim: Lunch is served in the STAC (Campus Center) from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. on move-in Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; continuous dining from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM during the semester.

cards.title: Class Photo at St. Charles
cards.subtitle: A Century of Tradition
cards.notes: Gather on the front steps of the college's oldest building for the official class photo. It's a landmark moment to document the start of your adventure.
cards.short_summary: The historic first building of Carroll College, used for the annual freshman class photo.
cards.evidence_claim: The freshman class photo is taken on the St. Charles front steps at 3:30 p.m. on orientation Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Exterior steps are publicly accessible; building houses classrooms and residences.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Official Academic Welcome
cards.notes: Join faculty and leadership in the gym for your formal induction. This ceremony marks your official entry into the Carroll academic community.
cards.short_summary: The Physical Education Center gym, host to major campus ceremonies and athletic events.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Convocation is held in the PE Center gym at 4:15 p.m. on orientation Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled orientation events; typically requires student ID for gym use.

cards.title: Sunday Night Mass
cards.subtitle: Spiritual Center of Campus
cards.notes: Attend the first Sunday Mass of the year. This modern chapel serves as the hub for campus ministry and personal reflection.
cards.short_summary: The central campus chapel dedicated in 2017 for worship and spiritual life.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunday Night Mass is held at 7:00 p.m. in All Saints Chapel during orientation weekend.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled services and daily prayer; all are welcome.

cards.title: Ice Cream Social
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Celebration
cards.notes: End your first day with live music and treats. It's a relaxed way to meet peers and say goodbye to family before the week begins.
cards.short_summary: The lawn outside Borromeo Hall, used for outdoor student social gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: An Ice Cream Social with the Casey Band is held on Borromeo Lawn at 8:15 p.m. on orientation Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space on campus; event is specifically for new students and families.

cards.title: Hike Mount Helena
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Adventure
cards.notes: Join the Carroll Adventure and Mountaineering Program (CAMP) for a hike. The 1906 Trail offers panoramic views of the Helena valley and campus.
cards.short_summary: A 620-acre city park with trails overlooking the city, popular for student outdoor trips.
cards.evidence_claim: New students participate in a hike up Mount Helena as part of the CAMP orientation activities.
cards.source_title: Carroll's Class of 2029 has been hitting the trail | Carroll College
cards.access_notes: Park is open daily from sunrise to sunset; trails are free to the public.

cards.title: Orientation Slip 'N Slide
cards.subtitle: A Signature Tradition
cards.notes: Cool off with this high-energy orientation tradition. It's a favorite way for freshmen to bond and celebrate the final days of summer.
cards.short_summary: The grassy slope near Guadalupe Hall used for the annual orientation slip 'n slide.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slip 'N Slide down Guad Hill is a featured activity during orientation week.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus area; event is scheduled specifically during orientation week.

cards.title: Fighting Saints Football
cards.subtitle: Saturday Game Day
cards.notes: Experience the 'Purple Reign' in the student section. Cheer on the Saints at this on-campus stadium with views of the Rockies.
cards.short_summary: The 4,812-seat on-campus stadium for Carroll football and soccer.
cards.evidence_claim: Nelson Stadium hosts Fighting Saints football games, including early-season matchups during the first weeks of school.
cards.access_notes: Open for ticketed events; student tickets are typically available through the college.

cards.title: Late Night Study Prep
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Wind-Down
cards.notes: Scope out your favorite study spot before classes start. The library offers quiet zones and coffee to help you prepare for your first Monday.
cards.short_summary: The Corette Library and Simperman Learning Commons, the primary academic resource center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corette Library is open on Sundays from noon to 8:00 p.m. during the fall semester.
cards.source_title: Library Fall Semester Hours 2025 | Carroll College
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 p.m. on Sundays; student ID required for certain services.
